headlines.title: Does Higher Data Center Guidance Change The Bull Case For American Tower Stock (AMT)?
headlines.summary: American Tower raised its full-year data center revenue growth outlook to about 15%, citing record leasing activity and healthier demand trends across that segment. The updated guidance highlights how data centers are becoming a more meaningful driver alongside American Tower's tower portfolio, with leasing momentum reinforcing management's focus on digital infrastructure scale.

headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Heads Into Earnings As Its Undervalued Narrative Faces A Big Test
headlines.summary: American Tower (AMT) heads into its third quarter 2026 earnings release on October 27, with investor attention fixed on how tower leasing, global sites and data center trends are shaping the overall story. The recent 1 month share price return of 10.65% and 90 day gain of 13.38% suggest momentum has picked up for American Tower. However, the 5 year total shareholder return is down 21.17%, which keeps questions about longer term value creation on the table.

headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Stock Could Still Be A Bargain Following A 22% Run
headlines.summary: American Tower has delivered a mixed ride for holders in recent years, and the recent share price around US$188.97 puts fresh focus on whether that level is supported by the cash the business can generate. For anyone looking at the stock today, the real issue is how that current quote lines up against an intrinsic value estimate grounded in its future cash flows. The share price has returned 22.

headlines.title: American Tower Stock Before Q3 Earnings: Smart Buy or Risky Move?
headlines.summary: AMT's Q3 results are expected to show revenue and AFFO growth, driven by 5G deployments, leasing demand and CoreSite's data center momentum.

headlines.title: These 3 REITs Own the Towers Behind America’s Wireless Networks. Which Pays Best?
headlines.summary: Three REITs quietly collect rent from the antennas powering every call and text in America, but their dividends tell very different stories about risk, safety, and how much longer each payout can hold.

description: American Tower Corporation one of the largest global REITs, is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate with a portfolio of over 148,000 communications sites and a highly interconnected footprint of U.S. data center facilities. American Tower Corporation was incorporated in 1995 in Delaware and is based in Massachusetts, Boston.
